symbols.name: address set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of addresses that indexes the array of values on each wire.
symbols.quote: The values on a wire form an array indexed by a finite address set $\Omega$, and a gate acts pointwise: at each fixed address it takes a linear combination, with scalar coefficients, of the values on the wires it touches.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible linear operator on arrays indexed by $\Omega$ attached to the source, gate or sink $v$.
symbols.quote: Each source, gate and sink $v$ carries an invertible linear operator $D_v$ on arrays indexed by $\Omega$, its *frame*.

relations.quote: Each frame is invertible, so it has full [matrix rank](matrix-rank.md) on the $|\Omega|$ addresses.
